objectives.description: Demonstrate all six verification-bar criteria with evidence; run repo lint gates; write implementation summary

deviations.reason: Discovered during this phase's own criterion-1 evidence run that the Phase 3/Phase 6 documented capture pattern `X=$(cmd | grep ... | sort -u); EXIT=$?` incorrectly captures sort -u's exit code, not verify-deploy.sh's own, because a pipeline inside a command substitution runs in a subshell whose PIPESTATUS does not propagate to the parent shell. Fixed by splitting into two steps in both skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md (Stage MT-3 step 7's Fire and post-success bullets) and skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md (the Transcribed summary's prose): capture the script's own exit code first as the sole command in its substitution, then filter the already-captured text as a separate step. Verified empirically both that the bug existed (PRE_EXIT/POST_EXIT read as 0 despite verify-deploy.sh actually exiting 1) and that the fix resolves it (PRE_EXIT/POST_EXIT correctly read 1).
deviations.annotation: recorded in Phase 7 checklist Criterion 1 evidence note
